proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A general Daisy saves from Creel, then helps kidnap.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who saves Talbot from Creel, then helps kidnap him.

their_evidence: AoS S2#1 'Shadows': as May fights Creel, Skye immobilizes him with a Taser Projectile Launcher, saving Talbot; after the team kidnaps Talbot, Skye watches Coulson question him.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#11

their_evidence: AoS S2#11 'Aftershocks': Simmons shows Skye Raina's altered DNA and harshly refers to those with powers as a plague, worrying Skye, who has changed; Fitz covers for Skye.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#21
proposed.text: When May refuses to leave Afterlife after the shooting, Skye fights her and knocks her out with her powers.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: May's trainee, who knocks her out in Afterlife.

their_evidence: AoS S2#21 'S.O.S. Part One': Skye confronts May, who is looking for Gonzales; when May refuses to leave Afterlife, they fight and Skye knocks May out with her powers (May forgives her in S2#22).

their_evidence: AoS S2#19 'The Dirty Half Dozen': Peterson is found in his cell by Coulson's team including Skye and Simmons; he sends Skye to save Lincoln Campbell.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Phil Coulson recruits Daisy Johnson into S.H.I.E.L.D. and becomes a father figure to her. She grows from a hacker on his plane into one of his most trusted agents.

stages.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's recruit and like a daughter to him, one of his most trusted agents.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
stages.text: The dying Coulson refuses the serum that could save him and hides it in Daisy's gauntlets so she can stop Talbot. He then says goodbye and leaves to spend his last days in Tahiti.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's recruiter and father figure. Gives up his cure so she can win, then says goodbye.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's recruit and like a daughter to him. He gives up his cure so she can stop Talbot.

proposed.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2#14
proposed.text: Coulson pulls Skye from active duty and takes her to a safe house, asking her to take time to learn to control her powers.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Daisy's recruiter, who takes her to a safe house to learn control.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's recruit, whom he sends away to learn control.

their_evidence: AoS S2#14 'Love in the Time of Hydra': on Garner's recommendation, Coulson pulls Skye from active duty and leaves her at a safe house with gloves, asking her to learn to control her powers.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A close friend who raids Hydra's last base with Peggy.

their_evidence: AoS S2#1 'Shadows' (1945 opening): Dugan, Carter and Morita capture the last known Hydra base in Austria, Dugan handcuffs Reinhardt, and they lock away the artifacts while Dugan asks Carter what they are.

proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fitz's old teacher, now in a rival S.H.I.E.L.D.

their_evidence: AoS S2#15 'One Door Closes': Weaver speaks to Fitz and Simmons, who are surprised to see her alive; she explains her survival and says Coulson has no right to call his organization S.H.I.E.L.D.
